slides.headline: How to delete your *Meta AI chats* for good

slides.heading: 1. Open *Manage your information*
paras: In the Meta AI app, tap Menu at the top left, then Settings at the bottom left.
Under App settings, tap Data & privacy, then Manage your information.

slides.heading: 2. Tap *Delete all chats and media*
paras: Confirm with Delete all. Your chats, prompts and media leave the History and Media sections.
On meta.ai, click your profile picture, then Settings and the same path.

slides.heading: 3. Remove your *public posts* too
paras: Deleting chats does not delete anything you shared publicly.

paras.t: On the same screen, tap Remove all public vibes (Remove all public posts on the web), then Remove all.

slides.hook: Follow for privacy guides that show you every button before you tap it.

paragraphs.text: How to delete Meta AI chats, in short: open Settings, go to Data & privacy, then Manage your information, and tap Delete all chats and media. That one screen exists in the Meta AI app, the Vibes app and on meta.ai in a browser, according to Meta's help center. It clears your history in one go. Anything you posted publicly needs a second button on the same screen.
This guide gives the exact taps for each version, then explains what deleting removes and what it leaves alone. It takes about a minute.
How to delete Meta AI chats in the Meta AI app

paragraphs.title: 1. Open Settings
paragraphs.text: Tap Menu at the top left of the Meta AI app, then tap Settings at the bottom left.

paragraphs.title: 2. Go to Manage your information
paragraphs.text: Under App settings, tap Data & privacy, then tap Manage your information. This is the same screen where Meta lets you export a copy of your information, so grab an export first if you want to keep anything.

paragraphs.title: 3. Delete everything
paragraphs.text: Tap Delete all chats and media, then confirm with Delete all. Meta says your chats, prompts and media will no longer show in the History section or the Media section of the app.
The delete option on this screen clears everything at once, so export first if some of it is worth keeping.
On the web at meta.ai

paragraphs.title: 4. On a computer
paragraphs.text: Go to www.meta.ai and click your profile picture at the bottom left. Click Settings, then Data & privacy, then Manage your information. Click Delete all chats and media, then Delete all. Meta says the chats, prompts and media then disappear from the History section and the Create section of the site.

paragraphs.title: 5. On a phone browser
paragraphs.text: Go to www.meta.ai, tap the Menu icon, then tap your profile picture at the bottom left. Tap Settings, Data & privacy and Manage your information, then Delete all chats and media and Delete all. In the mobile browser, Meta calls the history area Recent instead of History.
In the Vibes app

paragraphs.title: 6. Clear Vibes too
paragraphs.text: Vibes keeps its own history. Tap Profile at the bottom right, then Settings at the top right, then Data & privacy and Manage your information. Tap Delete all chats and media, then Delete all.
Remove your public posts and vibes

Deleting your chats does not delete anything you made public, Meta's help center says. Public vibes and public posts are a separate step, and other people's vibes that include you stay visible unless you remove them under Media that includes me.

paragraphs.title: 7. Remove all public vibes in the app
paragraphs.text: On the same Manage your information screen in the Meta AI or Vibes app, tap Remove all public vibes, then Remove all.

paragraphs.title: 8. Remove all public posts on the web
paragraphs.text: On meta.ai, follow the same path and click Remove all public posts, then Remove all.

paragraphs.title: 9. Remove just one
paragraphs.text: To take down a single vibe in the Meta AI app, tap Menu, then your profile picture at the bottom right, open the vibe, tap the Menu icon and choose Remove from feed. In the Vibes app, start from Profile instead. On the web, open the post, click the Menu icon and choose Remove from feed.

Removing a vibe from the feed does not erase it. Meta says removed vibes and posts stay in your Media or Create section, where you can post them again. Delete your chats and media as well if you want them gone.
What deleting does not cover

Voice chats behave a little differently. Meta says the recording of a voice conversation is only in your history temporarily, while the text transcript stays until you delete it. If you posted a prompt using your voice, the recording stays until you delete that post.

Meta's help page also says it uses your interactions with its AI to improve AI at Meta, and that when the AI cannot answer, it shares your messages and general information such as your region with select partners. Depending on where you live, your interactions can also personalize content and ads. The page does not say how long Meta keeps data after you delete it.

Meta AI also builds memories about you, separate from chat history. In December 2025, The Washington Post's Geoffrey A. Fowler reported that you cannot stop Meta AI from creating memories, but you can delete them one by one in Settings under Memory. He also reported that Meta offered no way to delete chats automatically on a schedule, and no setting to stop chat contents from being used to target ads.
Fowler's rule of thumb is a good one: do not tell a chatbot anything you would not want to see on social media. Deleting afterward helps, but not sharing it in the first place helps more.

Meta AI also runs inside Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp, and each app has its own help page for those chats, according to Meta's help center. The steps in this guide cover the Meta AI app, Vibes and meta.ai.

The honest limit of this tool is that it controls what you can see, not everything Meta keeps. Meta's page describes what disappears from your History, Media and Create sections. It does not promise that the data is erased from Meta's systems right away, so treat deletion as cleanup, not a guarantee.
